sar.narrative: Customer C07297 reported that they did not authorize transaction 3476682, triggering a fraud investigation into card C07297-K1. On 2016-11-21, four online purchases were made within a 30-minute window: 3476602 ($478.95), 3476633 ($456.96), 3476665 ($488.04), and 3476682 ($482.12). These transactions occurred via a device profile identified as Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080, which is new to this account and has been used by 494 other customers. The activity is suspicious because each transaction was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold to avoid detection, a pattern known as threshold hugging. Additionally, these amounts exceed the customer's typical p95 spending profile of $320.95. This behavior matches five previously closed fraud cases, including CC-5538, CC-5539, CC-5541, CC-5556, and CC-5564. The total exposure for this activity is $1906.07.
